title: Shared Chest
description: GlobalChest is a lightweight and efficient utility plugin for Paper/Spigot servers that provides a shared inventory accessible to all players via a simple command.
body:
Overview
GlobalChest is a lightweight and efficient utility plugin for Paper/Spigot servers that provides a shared inventory accessible to all players via a simple command. It’s perfect for community-driven servers where players want to share resources, tools, or gifts in a central "Public Box."

Features
- Shared Global Inventory: One single chest for the entire server.

- Persistent Storage: All items are automatically saved to a configuration file when the server  stops or restarts, ensuring no items are lost.

- Simple Commands: Easy access with /kiste, /chest, or /gc.

- Lightweight: Minimal impact on server performance.

- Safety First: Includes checks to prevent console or command blocks from triggering inventory errors.

Commands
/kiste - Opens the global shared chest. (Aliases: /chest, /gc)
